_comment: Regulatory passports for 26 molecules. Captures pharmacopeia monographs, Orange Book RLD/TE codes, exclusivity, and development context. Hand-curated; live FDA Orange Book / EMA refresh planned.

exclusivity.description: New Chemical/Clinical Investigation exclusivity on original indication
Orphan drug exclusivity for certain indications

passports.bioequivalence_notes: Biosimilar pathway; analytical/functional similarity + clinical immunogenicity required

exclusivity.description: Orphan drug exclusivity for multiple myeloma

passports.bioequivalence_notes: Biosimilar; IV and subcutaneous Faspro formulations have different immunogenicity/EXKIVITY considerations
passports.notes: Subcutaneous Darzalex Faspro adds formulation/device protection

passports.bioequivalence_notes: Biosimilar; PD-1 binding/functional assays + clinical PK/PD
passports.notes: Combination therapy patents extend commercial risk
